data: Film spremlja Tilna, postavnega gimnazijca, ki svoji trenutni punci, v upanju na izgubo nedolžnosti, s figo v žepu priseže večno zvestobo. Sosledje nenadnih in neprijetnih dogodkov pa Tilnu kmalu zamaje tla pod nogami. Prepričanje, da je uročen, mu preprečuje zbližanje s sošolko Saro, pravo ljubeznijo njegovega življenja. (In 1942, Christian writer Jochen Klepper lived with his Jewish wife and daughter in Berlin, Germany. Their applications to emigrate got rejected and they became part of the last and sad defense of the Jewish-Christian community.)
